name: Shinmeiji Riri
source:
A third-year student at St.Trea Academy. President of the board game club. She is a little bit selfish and assertive, like a "villain". 

She is not a bad girl at heart, and not unpleasant. She is the daughter of a president of a board game company and she personally loves board games. 

Her great ambition is to "get more people around the world playing board games."

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/shangrila/chartop.html]official site[/url]]

•[b]Boob Shape[/b]
[b]Cone shaped (Torpedo Boobs)[/b]
